thinking_text:
**Structuring sections**

I'm planning to outline five sections. The first is the annular web, covering faces 12 and 34, which are major. 

The second section will focus on the inner aperture wall, including faces 8, 9, 10, 11, 33, 45, 46, and 47 — all major. 

Then, the third section addresses the outer perimeter crown with faces 35 to 42, again all major. 

For the fourth section, I'm considering the front edge transition loops, covering faces 0-7 and 13-20, but I need to clarify if we should distinguish the front.

part.name: Rounded rectangular perimeter frame
part.description: A single-piece, closed-loop rectangular frame with long straight rails, large-radius corners, a continuous central opening, broad annular front and rear lands, a defined inner aperture wall, and a rounded outer perimeter shell. No discrete fastener holes, bosses, hinges, or detachable joints are visible.
part.symmetry_note: The rounded-rectangle planform is approximately bilaterally symmetric about both in-plane center axes. The through-thickness profile is asymmetric: the two broad annular lands have different visible areas and are connected to different inner and outer transition profiles.

Section.name: Primary annular flange
Section.function intent: Provides the principal broad contact, mounting, support, or sealing land around the central opening and ties all four rails and corner regions into one continuous frame.
Section.physical behavior: Acts primarily as an in-plane membrane and bending flange. Its large continuous area spreads contact pressure and local edge loads around the complete perimeter, while the closed-loop geometry resists racking of the rounded rectangle.
Section.geometry: A broad planar annulus bounded by an outer rounded rectangle and an inner rounded rectangle. The face is continuous around the opening and includes four straight rail regions blended through four rounded corners.
Section.location: On the visually dominant broad side of the frame, spanning the entire rounded-rectangular planform.

major_faces.name: Primary annular face
major_faces.description: Largest planar ring-shaped face, bounded by inner and outer rounded-rectangular loops and visible as the principal broad flange surface.

Section.name: Secondary annular land
Section.function intent: Provides an opposing contact or backing land and closes the frame cross-section between the inner aperture boundary and outer perimeter shell.
Section.physical behavior: Carries compressive reaction and bending loads transferred through the inner and outer walls. Although narrower than the primary flange, its continuous closed-loop form stabilizes the frame and limits twisting of the perimeter rails.
Section.geometry: A planar rounded-rectangular annulus on the opposite side of the frame. It is substantially narrower in exposed area than the primary annular flange and is bounded by narrow inner and outer transition bands.
Section.location: Opposite the primary annular flange across the part thickness.

major_faces.name: Secondary annular face
major_faces.description: Opposing planar ring face forming the narrower rear or secondary land around the central opening.

Section.name: Inner aperture interface
Section.function intent: Defines the usable central opening, provides clearance for an inserted component or panel, and can laterally locate or seal against a rounded-rectangular mating part.
Section.physical behavior: The continuous inner wall reacts lateral contact loads from a mating component and constrains in-plane translation. Large-radius corner patches avoid sharp stress concentrations, while the narrow edge fillets reduce local contact stress and improve insertion or sealing behavior.
Section.geometry: A closed rounded-rectangular wall composed of four straight facets and four cylindrical corner patches. Narrow radius-2 transition loops connect the wall to the two annular lands.
Section.location: Around the inside boundary of the frame, directly surrounding the large central opening.

major_faces.name: Lower inner straight wall
major_faces.description: Long planar inner-aperture facet along one long rail, adjacent to both lower inner corner patches.

major_faces.name: Lower-right inner corner
major_faces.description: Radius-50 cylindrical corner patch connecting the lower inner rail to the right inner sidewall.

major_faces.name: Right inner straight wall
major_faces.description: Planar inner-aperture facet along the right short side of the central opening.

major_faces.name: Upper-right inner corner
major_faces.description: Radius-50 cylindrical corner patch joining the right inner sidewall to the upper inner rail.

major_faces.name: Upper inner straight wall
major_faces.description: Long planar inner-aperture facet opposite the lower inner wall.

major_faces.name: Upper-left inner corner
major_faces.description: Radius-50 cylindrical corner patch joining the upper inner rail to the left inner sidewall.

major_faces.name: Left inner straight wall
major_faces.description: Planar inner-aperture facet along the left short side of the central opening.

major_faces.name: Lower-left inner corner
major_faces.description: Radius-50 cylindrical corner patch closing the inner-wall loop between the left side and lower rail.

Section.name: Outer perimeter shell
Section.function intent: Forms the external envelope of the frame, protects the edge, carries handling and impact loads, and stiffens the broad annular lands against bending and racking.
Section.physical behavior: Behaves as a continuous closed rim or edge beam. The curved crown redirects transverse contact loads into the straight rails, while the large-radius corner sweeps and fillet transitions distribute stress without abrupt section changes.
Section.geometry: A closed rounded-rectangular outer shell with four long or short straight swept surfaces and four toroidal or cylindrical corner regions. One narrow outer wall loop transitions into a broader radius-10 rounded crown; a radius-2 transition loop joins the shell to the primary flange.
Section.location: At the extreme outside boundary of the part, encircling all other sections.

major_faces.name: Lower outer narrow wall
major_faces.description: Long planar outer-perimeter strip along the lower rail of the narrow outer wall loop.

major_faces.name: Lower-right outer narrow corner
major_faces.description: Radius-63 cylindrical corner patch joining the lower outer strip to the right outer side.

major_faces.name: Right outer narrow wall
major_faces.description: Planar outer-perimeter strip along the right short side.

major_faces.name: Upper-right outer narrow corner
major_faces.description: Radius-63 cylindrical corner patch between the right side and upper outer strip.

major_faces.name: Upper outer narrow wall
major_faces.description: Long planar outer-perimeter strip opposite the lower outer narrow wall.

major_faces.name: Upper-left outer narrow corner
major_faces.description: Radius-63 cylindrical corner patch between the upper strip and left outer side.

major_faces.name: Left outer narrow wall
major_faces.description: Planar outer-perimeter strip along the left short side.

major_faces.name: Lower-left outer narrow corner
major_faces.description: Radius-63 cylindrical corner patch closing the narrow outer wall loop.

major_faces.name: Lower-left rounded crown
major_faces.description: Radius-10 toroidal sweep around the lower-left outer corner, adjacent to the lower and left crown rails.

major_faces.name: Lower rounded crown rail
major_faces.description: Long radius-10 cylindrical swept surface forming the rounded outer crown along the lower rail.

major_faces.name: Lower-right rounded crown
major_faces.description: Radius-10 toroidal outer corner connecting the lower crown rail to the right crown rail.

major_faces.name: Right rounded crown rail
major_faces.description: Radius-10 cylindrical swept surface forming the protective crown along the right short side.

major_faces.name: Upper-right rounded crown
major_faces.description: Radius-10 toroidal outer corner connecting the right and upper crown rails.

major_faces.name: Upper rounded crown rail
major_faces.description: Long radius-10 cylindrical swept surface forming the rounded outer crown along the upper rail.

major_faces.name: Upper-left rounded crown
major_faces.description: Radius-10 toroidal outer corner connecting the upper crown rail to the left crown rail.

major_faces.name: Left rounded crown rail
major_faces.description: Radius-10 cylindrical swept surface forming the protective crown along the left short side.
